kultivator.screen.help.dunia_batin.title: The Inner World
kultivator.screen.help.dunia_batin: Your inner world is born when you ascend to the Immortal Realm, graded by your breakthroughs (Small 4 plots, Medium 6, Great 9, Supreme 12 with a flawless path). It never runs on its own: days are counted when you open the Batin tablet (Immortality scroll) and every few seconds while you play, at most 10 at once. One outside day is two inner years. Plant spirit herbs in its plots (click with a herb in your main hand): they age 25 years a day times the Fertility of your foxes (+1%% per 100 foxes, at most +40%%), up to 3,000; a harvest from 1,000 years gives a second herb. Pearls fill each day by grade: take them out, brew them into Immortal Qi (1%% of your bar each, 5 a day) or spend them on Fortify and Created Arts. Feed 64 ores once to wake the rockmen; then they eat ore from the pit and make Mid and High spirit stones and, every 7th day, an Immortal Origin Stone. Every 5 days (configurable) an earthly calamity comes: if you are online, active and on open ground it comes live around you for 90 seconds (Meteor Fire Rain: break the meteors in the air; Great Flood: hold the Qi Dam circle for 60 seconds; Lightning Shadow: slay it, inside the Dang Hun ring it takes double damage), otherwise it passes as data with a chance raised by Fortify. Losses are plots and inner numbers only, never your items or blocks. Source: Reverend Insanity ch. 409 "Managing the Blessed Land"; every number is game design.
kultivator.screen.help.jurus_ciptaan: A Dewa Abadi Peak with an inner world can create up to three techniques of their own on the Ciptaan tablet: choose two Daos comprehended to 60 (or one Dao at 90 for a pure art, +15%%), one of six forms (Cut, Burst, Rain, Wave, Domain, Seal) and a name of up to 24 characters. The Creation Enlightenment is a 60 second channel standing still; costs (20 pearls, 1 primordial material, 10%% of your bar in Immortal Qi) are taken only when it ends. Perfection follows your comprehension and the primordial kinds you slew (55-100%%); Perfect re-rolls it for half the cost and keeps the better. The art is a Dewa ultimate with your name in the Book of Techniques: damage = form coefficient (14-18) x Perfection x power, plus both Daos' domain pulses and their fusion pair. Source: I Shall Seal the Heavens ch. 1379 ("my own Ninth Hex"), Battle Through the Heavens ch. 262 and 363, Coiling Dragon; forms and numbers are game design.
